'''Minister of the Navy''' was a ministerial position within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. The office holder was the ministerial head of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. The post was abolished<ref name="CTD" /> by [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> and the responsibilities were taken by the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]].<ref name="CTD" />
